_comment: Team strength ratings (Elo-style, ~1500 = average international side, ~2100 = elite). Edit freely — e.g. knock a team down 40-60 points for a major injury. Any team not listed gets the default (1600) and is logged by the sync so you can add it. Duplicate keys below are aliases for football-data.org naming.
_wc2026_note: Updated June 2026 to reflect all 48 FIFA World Cup 2026 qualified teams. Italy, Denmark, Poland, Scotland, Wales, and Ireland did NOT qualify. New entrants: Bosnia and Herzegovina, Sweden, Turkey, Czechia (UEFA playoffs), DR Congo and Iraq (inter-confederation playoffs), plus WC debutants Cape Verde, Curaçao, Jordan, Uzbekistan. South Africa added as opening-match participant.
